periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation angled approximately 45 degrees downward from the medial to the lateral canthus relative to the horizontal facial axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated teardrop morphology with a vertical axis significantly greater than the horizontal width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering where the patch extends substantially below the geometric center of the eye.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shape curve along the posterior margin with a gentle dip towards the spine.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Substantial lateral thickness, estimated at approximately 30% of the visible dorsal-ventral torso depth.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide separation distance between dark ear regions, approximately 1.5 to 2 times the width of a single ear.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Regular semi-circular profile with high curvature smoothness and rounded tops.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced brownish-yellow pelage oxidation/staining on the dorsal white fur posterior to the cervical region.
